name: Bob
blurb: Bob is a lackadaisical teenager. In conversation, his responses are very limited.
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to determine what Bob will reply to someone when they say something to him or ask him a question.

Bob only ever answers one of five things:

- **"Sure."**
  This is his response if you ask him a question, such as "How are you?"
  The convention used for questions is that it ends with a question mark.
- **"Whoa, chill out!"**
  This is his answer if you YELL AT HIM.
  The convention used for yelling is ALL CAPITAL LETTERS.
- **"Calm down, I know what I'm doing!"**
  This is what he says if you yell a question at him.
- **"Fine. Be that way!"**
  This is how he responds to silence.
  The convention used for silence is nothing, or various combinations of whitespace characters.
- **"Whatever."**
  This is what he answers to anything else.
introduction:
# Introduction

Bob is a [lackadaisical][] teenager.
He likes to think that he's very cool.
And he definitely doesn't get excited about things.
That wouldn't be cool.

When people talk to him, his responses are pretty limited.

[lackadaisical]: https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/lackadaisical

example_solution:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BOB.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-HEYBOB                PIC X(60).
       01 WS-HEYBOB-ARRAY REDEFINES WS-HEYBOB.
          02 WS-HEYBOB-CHAR        PIC X OCCURS 60 TIMES
                INDEXED BY BOB-INDEX.
             88 UPPERCASE-LETTERS
                  VALUES 'A' THRU 'I'
                         'J' THRU 'R'
                         'S' THRU 'Z'.
             88 LOWERCASE-LETTERS
                  VALUES 'a' THRU 'i'
                         'j' THRU 'r'
                         's' THRU 'z'.
       01 WS-RESULT                PIC X(40).
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
          02 WS-SPACE-COUNTER      PIC 99.
          02 WS-UPPER-COUNTER      PIC 99.
          02 WS-LOWER-COUNTER      PIC 99.
       01 QUESTIONING              PIC X.
          88 IS-QUESTION VALUE "?".
       01 WS-UPPER PIC X(26)
            VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
       01 WS-LOWER PIC X(26)
            VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       BOB.
           MOVE ZEROES TO WS-COUNTERS.
           INSPECT WS-HEYBOB TALLYING WS-SPACE-COUNTER FOR ALL SPACE.
         
           PERFORM VARYING BOB-INDEX
              FROM LENGTH OF WS-HEYBOB
              BY -1
              UNTIL WS-HEYBOB-CHAR(BOB-INDEX) = "?"
              OR WS-HEYBOB-CHAR(BOB-INDEX) NOT = SPACE
                   CONTINUE
           END-PERFORM.
           MOVE WS-HEYBOB-CHAR(BOB-INDEX) TO QUESTIONING.
         
           PERFORM VARYING BOB-INDEX
              FROM 1
              BY 1
              UNTIL BOB-INDEX > LENGTH OF WS-HEYBOB
                   IF UPPERCASE-LETTERS(BOB-INDEX)   
                      ADD 1 TO WS-UPPER-COUNTER
                   END-IF
                   IF LOWERCASE-LETTERS(BOB-INDEX)   
                      ADD 1 TO WS-LOWER-COUNTER
                   END-IF
           END-PERFORM.
      * use evaluate and include where lower and upper counts are zero 

           IF WS-SPACE-COUNTER = LENGTH OF WS-HEYBOB
              MOVE "Fine. Be that way!" TO WS-RESULT
           ELSE
              EVALUATE TRUE ALSO TRUE 
              WHEN WS-UPPER-COUNTER = 0 ALSO WS-LOWER-COUNTER > 0
                   IF IS-QUESTION
                      MOVE "Sure." TO WS-RESULT
                   ELSE
                      MOVE "Whatever." TO WS-RESULT
                   END-IF
              WHEN WS-UPPER-COUNTER = 0 ALSO WS-LOWER-COUNTER = 0
                   IF IS-QUESTION
                      MOVE "Sure." TO WS-RESULT
                   ELSE
                      MOVE "Whatever." TO WS-RESULT
                   END-IF
              WHEN WS-UPPER-COUNTER > 0 ALSO WS-LOWER-COUNTER = 0
                   IF IS-QUESTION 
                      MOVE "Calm down, I know what I'm doing!" TO
                         WS-RESULT
                   ELSE
                      MOVE "Whoa, chill out!" TO WS-RESULT
                   END-IF 
              WHEN WS-UPPER-COUNTER > 0 ALSO WS-LOWER-COUNTER > 0
                   IF IS-QUESTION
                      MOVE "Sure." TO WS-RESULT
                   ELSE
                      MOVE "Whatever." TO WS-RESULT
                   END-IF
              END-EVALUATE
           END-IF.
test_code:
TestCase "stating something"
	MOVE "Tom-ay-to, tom-aaaah-to." TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whatever."

TestCase "shouting"
	MOVE "WATCH OUT!" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whoa, chill out!"

TestCase "shouting gibberish"
	MOVE "FCECDFCAAB" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whoa, chill out!"

TestCase "asking a question"
	MOVE "Does this cryogenic chamber make me look fat?" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Sure."

TestCase "asking a numeric question"
	MOVE "You are, what, like 15?" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Sure."

TestCase "asking gibberish"
	MOVE "fffbbcbeab?" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Sure."

TestCase "talking forcefully"
	MOVE "Hi there!" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whatever."

TestCase "using acronyms in regular speech"
	MOVE "It's OK if you don't want to go work for NASA." TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whatever."

TestCase "forceful question"
	MOVE "WHAT'S GOING ON?" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Calm down, I know what I'm doing!"

TestCase "shouting numbers"
	MOVE "1, 2, 3 GO!" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whoa, chill out!"

TestCase "no letters"
	MOVE "1, 2, 3" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whatever."

TestCase "question with no letters"
	MOVE "4?" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Sure."

TestCase "shouting with special characters"
	MOVE "ZOMG THE %^*@#$(*^ ZOMBIES ARE COMING!!11!!1!" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whoa, chill out!"

TestCase "shouting with no exclamation mark"
	MOVE "I HATE THE DENTIST" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whoa, chill out!"

TestCase "statement containing question mark"
	MOVE "Ending with ? means a question." TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whatever."

TestCase "non-letters with question"
	MOVE ":) ?" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Sure."

TestCase "prattling on"
	MOVE "Wait! Hang on. Are you going to be OK?" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Sure."

TestCase "silence"
	MOVE SPACE TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Fine. Be that way!"

TestCase "prolonged silence"
	MOVE "          " TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Fine. Be that way!"

TestCase "alternate silence"
	MOVE "          " TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Fine. Be that way!"

TestCase "multiple line question"
	MOVE "Does this cryogenic chamber make me look fat?
No." TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whatever."

TestCase "starting with whitespace"
	MOVE "         hmmmmmmm..." TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whatever."

TestCase "ending with whitespace"
	MOVE "Okay if like my  spacebar  quite a bit?   " TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Sure."

TestCase "other whitespace"
	MOVE "	
	" TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Fine. Be that way!"

TestCase "non-question ending with whitespace"
	MOVE "This is a statement ending with whitespace      " TO WS-HEYBOB
	PERFORM BOB
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "Whatever."
